# bugs #3563: mcs51: two live variables share stack space after inlining with --stack-auto

- Ticket: https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/bugs/3563/
- Category: [Fixes that need a decision](../../fix-decision.md)
- Evidence: tested on r17193
- Recommended action: Decide whether the block widening belongs in mcs51 or in shared code, apply, and close.
- Patch: [bugs-3563.patch](../../patches/bugs-3563.patch), commit [`224fd7f8a`](https://github.com/mdmower/sdcc/commit/224fd7f8a1816137ffbf35015a88d6d1a6308b69). Applies to r17193 without the other patches.
<!-- end of generated block -->

## Finding

With `--stack-auto`, two variables that are live at the same time can receive overlapping stack
offsets after a function is inlined. In the ticket's program, `rel` and `rd_idx` then contain bytes
of the buffer pointer. A maintainer derived `tests/bug-3563.c` from that program, and in trunk a
guard that names this ticket disables the test for mcs51. After the guard is removed, the test
fails on r17158 for mcs51-small-stack-auto and mcs51-large-stack-auto.

## Cause

`redoStackOffsets` in `src/SDCCmem.c` assigns stack offsets through `btree_alloc` in
`src/SDCCbtree.cc`, which starts the variables of sibling blocks at the same offset. That is correct
only while each variable is live inside its own block. After inlining and copy propagation, a
variable from the body of one inline function is live inside the body of the next one. In the test
a 3-byte variable is placed over a 2-byte variable that is live at that point.

`create_cfg` in `src/SDCCralloc.hpp` prevents this for the ports that use the newer register
allocator. For each variable it replaces `block` by the lowest common ancestor of the blocks in
which the variable is live, and it treats the spill location of the variable in this way too. A
`TODO` comment there states that the step should also work with the old allocator. mcs51 uses the
old allocator.

## Fix

The patch adds `widenBlocks` to `src/mcs51/ralloc.c`, which performs that step from the `rlive`
sets of the iCodes. `mcs51_assignRegisters` calls it before `redoStackOffsets`. The patch also
removes the guard from `tests/bug-3563.c`.

## Decision

The patch changes mcs51 only. The alternative is one implementation in shared code, as the `TODO`
comment says, which would cover every port that uses the old allocator. Those ports were not
examined for this report. A maintainer wrote in the second comment that the problem was seen for
mcs51 with `--stack-auto` only.

The patch has a cost. Variables that are live outside their own block receive stack space that
sibling blocks cannot reuse. In the regression suite the stack offsets change in about 170 tests
of the mcs51 stack-auto targets, and the total code size grows by 0.07%.

## Verification

After the guard is removed, `tests/bug-3563.c` fails for mcs51-small-stack-auto and
mcs51-large-stack-auto without the patch and passes for both with it.

## Related

[r9968](https://sourceforge.net/p/sdcc/code/9968/), the fix for bug #2567, extended the step in
`create_cfg` to the spill location.
